lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno found a giant leaf,
And flipped it over, what a relief!
Kiki laughed, that's not the plan,
It means a fresh start, if you can!
[chorus]
Turn over a new leaf, turn over a new leaf,
A fresh new start, beyond belief!
Turn over a new leaf, turn over a new leaf,
A happy start, a sweet relief!
[verse]
It means you start all fresh and new,
Better habits, kinder too,
A brand new year, a brand new way,
Let's make it better from today!
[chorus]
Turn over a new leaf, turn over a new leaf,
A fresh new start, beyond belief!
Turn over a new leaf, turn over a new leaf,
Happy New Year, fresh as a leaf!
[outro]
So as the old year comes to an end,
Turn over a new leaf, my friend!
